enable_ssh.description: Enable NETCONF access over SSH (RFC 6241 default transport).

ssh_listen_address.description: IP address (or hostname) on which to listen for SSH-based NETCONF connections.

ssh_listen_port.description: TCP port for SSH-based NETCONF (IANA-assigned default: 830).

ssh_host_key_file.description: Path to SSH server host private key (RSA, ECDSA, or Ed25519). Leave unset to use system default.

enable_tls.description: Enable NETCONF over TLS (RFC 7589). Requires TLS certificate and key.

tls_listen_address.description: IP address to bind for TLS-based NETCONF (only used if enable_tls = true).

tls_listen_port.description: TCP port for TLS-based NETCONF (IANA-assigned default: 6513).

tls_server_cert_file.description: Path to TLS server certificate (PEM format, required if enable_tls = true).

tls_server_key_file.description: Path to TLS server private key (PEM format, required if enable_tls = true).

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate for client verification (PEM format, optional but recommended if enable_tls = true).

allowed_users.description: List of users explicitly allowed to connect via NETCONF (ignored if auth-method = key-based with no restriction).

name.description: System username allowed to access NETCONF.

lock_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before automatically releasing a held configuration lock (0 = no timeout).

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent NETCONF sessions.

enable_nmda.description: Enable support for NETCONF Data Models with Defaults (NMDA, RFC 8526).

yang_module_paths.description: Search paths for YANG modules (semicolon or space-separated in some implementations, but list per line here).

custom_rpcs.description: Custom RPC module definitions (e.g., vendor-specific operations).

name.description: Human-readable name for the RPC module.

module.description: YANG module name implementing the RPC (e.g., 'example-vendor').

path.description: Absolute path to the YANG module file (optional if on YANG path).

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for log messages.

log_file.description: Path to file for log output (if omitted, use syslog/ stderr).
